rows.grounds: numeral forming first member of compound with patra
second member of compound describing the cakra
adjective indicating presence of a central pericarp

items.question: What are the defining characteristics of the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified as royal.
The sixth cakra has eight petals.
The sixth cakra possesses a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is a royal eight-petaled center with a pericarp.
uncertainties: The exact referent of rājānam as a metaphorical epithet is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: The sixth cakra is royal, eight-petaled, and has a pericarp.
